tagline: Bridge product specs in Notion with engineering issues in Linear
metaTitle: Notion + Linear Integration: Specs to Linear Issues
metaDescription: Turn Notion specs into Linear issues with acceptance criteria and alert engineers when a spec changes. GAIA keeps docs and tickets aligned. See the setup steps.
intro: Product teams write specs in Notion. Engineers build from Linear issues. The handoff between the two is often a lossy manual process where context gets dropped, scope shifts, and spec intent doesn't make it into the actual implementation. GAIA automates the spec-to-issue pipeline so engineering always works from current product intent.

useCases.title: Convert Notion specs to Linear issues
useCases.description: GAIA reads product requirement pages in Notion and generates a set of structured issues covering each requirement, preserving context and linking back to the source spec.

useCases.title: Spec change notifications to engineering
useCases.description: When a spec page is updated, GAIA detects the change and comments on related issues to alert engineers that requirements have changed, linking to the updated section.

useCases.title: Acceptance criteria carried into issues
useCases.description: GAIA extracts acceptance criteria defined in the spec pages and adds them to the description of corresponding issues so engineers have clear completion criteria.

useCases.title: Linear progress reflected in Notion
useCases.description: GAIA updates spec pages with current issue status so product teams can see development progress in the tool they use without checking Linear.

useCases.title: Sprint planning from product roadmap
useCases.description: During sprint planning, GAIA reads the product roadmap and creates a sprint with issues pre-populated from the roadmap items scheduled for the sprint period.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Notion workspace and Linear account. Specify which databases contain specs and which teams and projects receive issues.
Tell GAIA how to interpret your spec structure, which sections become issue titles, which become descriptions, and how to infer priority and labels from the spec content.
GAIA creates the initial issues from the specs and monitors for updates to either, keeping both sides aligned throughout the development cycle.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle Notion databases with multiple spec formats?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA adapts to your database structure. You describe how your specs are organized and GAIA learns to extract the right information from each page type.

faqs.question: Can engineers update Linear issues without affecting specs?
faqs.answer: Changes to issues flow back to the specs only where you configure them to (like updating a status field). Engineers can work freely without risking spec content changes.

faqs.question: Does this work with page templates?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your team uses a spec template, GAIA can be configured to recognize the template structure and create consistent issues from every spec that uses it.
